name: 零售
en_sentense: This shop sells goods by retail.
zh_sentense: 这家店铺做零售生意。

name: 批发
en_sentense: Wholesale goods have lower unit prices.
zh_sentense: 批发商品单价更低。

name: 质量
en_sentense: We choose products with good quality.
zh_sentense: 我们挑选质量优良的商品。

name: 包装
en_sentense: The beautiful pack attracts more buyers.
zh_sentense: 精美的包装吸引更多顾客。

name: 配送
en_sentense: Online shopping needs home delivery.
zh_sentense: 网购商品需要送货上门。

name: 快递员
en_sentense: The courier delivers parcels every morning.
zh_sentense: 快递员每天早上派送包裹。

name: 包裹
en_sentense: I receive a big parcel from my uncle.
zh_sentense: 我收到叔叔寄来的大包裹。

name: 授粉
en_sentense: Bees help flowers pollinate naturally.
zh_sentense: 蜜蜂帮助花朵自然授粉。

name: 发芽
en_sentense: Seeds germinate when they get water and sunshine.
zh_sentense: 种子有水和阳光就会发芽。

name: 开花
en_sentense: Roses bloom fully in late spring.
zh_sentense: 玫瑰在晚春尽情绽放。

name: 成熟
en_sentense: The apples ripen in autumn.
zh_sentense: 苹果在秋天成熟。

name: 光合作用
en_sentense: Green plants make food through photosynthesis.
zh_sentense: 绿色植物依靠光合作用制造养分。

name: 呼吸
en_sentense: All animals need to respire oxygen.
zh_sentense: 所有动物都需要呼吸氧气。

name: 养分
en_sentense: Roots absorb nutrients from the soil.
zh_sentense: 根系从土壤中吸收养分。

name: 氧气
en_sentense: Humans cannot live without oxygen.
zh_sentense: 人类离开氧气无法生存。

name: 二氧化碳
en_sentense: Plants take in carbon dioxide in the daytime.
zh_sentense: 植物白天吸收二氧化碳。

name: 氮气
en_sentense: Nitrogen takes up most of the air.
zh_sentense: 空气中大部分成分为氮气。

name: 大气层
en_sentense: The atmosphere protects the Earth from space rocks.
zh_sentense: 大气层保护地球免受陨石撞击。

name: 环形山
en_sentense: Many craters cover the moon's surface.
zh_sentense: 月球表面遍布环形山。

name: 小行星
en_sentense: Asteroids move around the sun too.
zh_sentense: 小行星也围绕太阳运转。

name: 彗星
en_sentense: A comet has a long bright tail when close to the sun.
zh_sentense: 彗星靠近太阳时会长出明亮长尾。

name: 日食月食
en_sentense: Solar eclipse does not happen very often.
zh_sentense: 日食并不会频繁出现。

name: 潮汐
en_sentense: The tide rises and falls twice every day.
zh_sentense: 潮汐每日涨落两次。

name: 无污染的
en_sentense: Pollution-free food is safer to eat.
zh_sentense: 无污染食品食用更安全。

name: 低碳的
en_sentense: We choose low-carbon ways to travel.
zh_sentense: 我们选择低碳出行方式。

name: 一次性的
en_sentense: Try not to use disposable chopsticks.
zh_sentense: 尽量不使用一次性筷子。

name: 生态的
en_sentense: We build ecological parks near the city.
zh_sentense: 城市周边修建生态公园。
